gloss: one year; for one year; period of one year

definitions.gloss: one year; period of one year
definitions.explanation: A duration of one year. The {間|かん} suffix emphasizes a continuous span of time, distinguishing this from {一年|いちねん}, which can also mean 'first year.'

examples.japanese: {一年間|いちねんかん}⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んだ→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I lived in Japan for one year.

examples.japanese: {一年間|いちねんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have one year of study-abroad experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一年間|いちねんかん}⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧で、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This insurance is valid for one year and must be renewed annually.

notes:
Adds the duration suffix ⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧ to ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧, making the meaning unambiguously 'for one year' rather than 'first year.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一年間|いちねんかん}⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue for one year
- {一年間|いちねんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧: a one-year plan
- {一年間|いちねんかん}⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧: valid for one year

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧: one year; first year — shorter, can be ambiguous between duration and ordinal
- ⟦{一年中|いちねんじゅう}→一年中：17104_ichinenjuu⟧: all year round; throughout the year
